title: Meat Processing Competition Act
snippet: To expand competition in livestock markets and fund small regional meat processing facilities.

title: Tableware Import Safety Act
snippet: To establish lead and cadmium safety standards for imported ceramic and porcelain tableware.

title: Countering Economic Coercion Act
snippet: To develop tools to support allies and partners subjected to economic coercion by an adversarial trading power in the Asia-Pacific.

title: Farm to Food Bank Act
snippet: To provide tax incentives for farmers who donate surplus crops to regional food banks.

title: China Exchange Rate Transparency Act
snippet: To direct United States representatives at international financial institutions to advocate for exchange rate transparency by China.

title: School Lunch Nutrition Act
snippet: To update nutrition standards for the national school lunch program and expand summer meal availability.

title: Protecting America From Chinese Espionage Act
snippet: To enhance counterintelligence efforts against espionage activities directed by the Government of the People's Republic of China.

title: Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act
snippet: To require annual certification of Hong Kong's autonomy from the People's Republic of China as a condition for special trade treatment.

title: Affordable Housing Credit Improvement Act
snippet: To expand the low-income housing tax credit and improve the allocation of credits to high-need areas.

title: Airport Infrastructure Modernization Act
snippet: To fund terminal improvements and runway safety projects at small and medium hub airports.

title: Foreign Apps Data Security Act
snippet: To restrict social media applications owned by ByteDance or subject to the jurisdiction of foreign adversary governments from Federal devices.

title: China Trade Enforcement Act
snippet: To direct the United States Trade Representative to investigate unfair trade practices by the People's Republic of China and impose duties on subsidized imports.

title: Rare Earth Independence Act
snippet: To establish a strategic reserve of rare earth elements and reduce dependence on a single dominant foreign supplier of critical minerals.

title: Postal Service Reform Act
snippet: To reform the financing of retiree health benefits for employees of the United States Postal Service.

title: Taiwan Strait Stability Act
snippet: To require an annual assessment of military balance across the Taiwan Strait and contingency planning for cross-strait conflict.

title: Social Security Fairness Act
snippet: To repeal the windfall elimination provision and government pension offset under title II of the Social Security Act.

title: China Financial Threat Mitigation Act
snippet: To require a report on exposure of the United States financial system to the People's Republic of China.

title: Small Business Tax Simplification Act
snippet: To simplify quarterly tax filing requirements for small businesses with fewer than fifty employees.

title: Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act
snippet: To prohibit the importation of goods produced with forced labor in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of the People's Republic of China.

title: Confucius Institute Transparency Act
snippet: To require institutions of higher education to disclose contracts with foreign government-sponsored cultural and language programs.

title: Ban Chinese Drones Act
snippet: To prohibit Federal agencies from procuring unmanned aircraft systems manufactured in the People's Republic of China.

title: Critical Minerals Processing Act
snippet: To incentivize domestic processing of critical minerals used in batteries and defense systems.

title: Flood Insurance Affordability Act
snippet: To reform the national flood insurance program and provide means-tested premium assistance.

title: Opioid Treatment Access Act
snippet: To expand access to medication-assisted treatment for opioid use disorder in underserved communities.

title: Solar Component Tariff Adjustment Act
snippet: To adjust tariff treatment of imported solar cells and modules to support domestic solar manufacturing.

title: Export Control Modernization Act
snippet: To modernize the export control system for emerging and foundational technologies with military applications.

title: Childhood Cancer Research Act
snippet: To expand pediatric cancer research programs at the National Institutes of Health.

title: Chinese Currency Accountability Act
snippet: To require the Secretary of the Treasury to analyze whether the People's Republic of China is manipulating the exchange rate of the renminbi.

title: Rural Hospital Stabilization Act
snippet: To provide enhanced Medicare payments to critical access hospitals at risk of closure.

title: Rural Broadband Expansion Act
snippet: To provide grants for the deployment of high-speed broadband infrastructure in unserved rural communities.

title: Historic Preservation Tax Credit Act
snippet: To enhance the rehabilitation tax credit for certified historic structures.

title: Taiwan Relations Reinforcement Act
snippet: To reaffirm the commitment of the United States to Taiwan in the face of military pressure from the People's Republic of China.

title: Court Interpreter Access Act
snippet: To improve access to qualified interpreters in Federal court proceedings.

title: United States-Japan Trade Agreement Act
snippet: To implement the trade agreement between the United States and Japan regarding agricultural and digital trade.

title: Digital Literacy for Seniors Act
snippet: To provide grants to public libraries for digital literacy training programs for older adults.

title: Student Loan Interest Relief Act
snippet: To reduce interest rates on Federal student loans and expand income-driven repayment options for borrowers.

title: Buy American Manufacturing Act
snippet: To strengthen domestic content requirements for Federal procurement of manufactured goods.

title: Telecommunications Adversary Equipment Ban
snippet: To prohibit Federal subsidies for telecommunications equipment produced by Huawei or ZTE.

title: Community Policing Grant Act
snippet: To reauthorize the community oriented policing services grant program and fund officer wellness initiatives.

title: Election Infrastructure Modernization Act
snippet: To provide grants to States for the replacement of aging voting equipment and post-election audits.

title: Teacher Loan Forgiveness Expansion Act
snippet: To expand loan forgiveness for teachers serving in high-need public schools.

title: Stop CCP Land Grabs Act
snippet: To prohibit the purchase of agricultural land in the United States by entities owned or controlled by the Government of the People's Republic of China.

title: Xinjiang Supply Chain Transparency Act
snippet: To require issuers to disclose whether their supply chains source polysilicon, cotton, or tomatoes from the Xinjiang region.

title: International Students STEM Retention Act
snippet: To provide a pathway for international students earning advanced STEM degrees to remain in the United States.

title: Arctic Strategy Act
snippet: To develop a comprehensive Arctic strategy addressing increased commercial and military activity by near-peer competitors.

title: Semiconductor Supply Chain Security Act
snippet: To reduce reliance on foreign adversaries for the fabrication of advanced semiconductors and to incentivize domestic chip manufacturing.

title: Clean Drinking Water Infrastructure Act
snippet: To provide funding for the replacement of lead service lines in public water systems.

title: Foreign Agricultural Land Disclosure Act
snippet: To require disclosure of foreign ownership of United States agricultural land to the Department of Agriculture.

title: Strategic Ports Security Act
snippet: To require review of foreign operation of cranes and logistics software at United States ports by companies domiciled in adversary nations.

title: Disaster Relief Flexibility Act
snippet: To provide State and local governments greater flexibility in the use of Federal disaster relief funds.

title: China Grid Security Act
snippet: To prohibit the acquisition of bulk-power system equipment manufactured in the People's Republic of China.

title: Supply Chain Resilience Act
snippet: To establish a program to map critical supply chains and reduce single-source foreign dependencies in essential industries.

title: Wildfire Prevention and Forest Management Act
snippet: To improve forest management practices and fund hazardous fuel reduction on Federal lands.

title: Countering Chinese Communist Party Influence Act
snippet: To counter the malign influence of the Chinese Communist Party in international organizations and to require annual reports on CCP-affiliated entities operating in the United States.

title: Veterans Mental Health Access Act
snippet: To expand access to mental health services for veterans in rural areas through telehealth grants administered by the Department of Veterans Affairs.

title: China Pandemic Accountability Act
snippet: To require a determination regarding the origins of COVID-19 and the role of the Government of the People's Republic of China in early reporting.

title: European Union Data Privacy Compatibility Act
snippet: To align cross-border data transfer rules with frameworks negotiated with the European Union.

title: Hong Kong Autonomy Review Act
snippet: To review export control treatment of a special administrative region following the imposition of a national security law.

title: Volunteer Emergency Responders Tax Relief Act
snippet: To provide a tax credit for volunteer firefighters and emergency medical personnel.

title: Youth Sports Safety Act
snippet: To establish concussion management guidelines for youth athletic programs receiving Federal funds.

title: South China Sea Freedom of Navigation Act
snippet: To reaffirm the commitment of the United States to freedom of navigation operations in the South China Sea and adjacent waters.

title: PRC Military Companies Sanctions Act
snippet: To impose sanctions on companies affiliated with the People's Liberation Army of the People's Republic of China.

title: National Parks Maintenance Act
snippet: To address the deferred maintenance backlog of the National Park Service and establish a legacy restoration fund.

title: Trans-Pacific Fisheries Enforcement Act
snippet: To combat illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing in the Pacific Ocean through expanded Coast Guard cooperation.

title: Indo-Pacific Deterrence Act
snippet: To strengthen the posture of the United States Armed Forces in the Indo-Pacific region and enhance security cooperation with regional allies facing coercion.

title: Hold China Accountable Act
snippet: To authorize civil actions against the Government of the People's Republic of China for damages relating to intellectual property theft.

title: Countering China's Belt and Road Act
snippet: To develop a strategy to provide alternatives to financing offered by China under the Belt and Road Initiative.

title: Beijing Winter Olympics Accountability Act
snippet: To express the sense of Congress regarding the participation of United States officials in the Beijing Winter Olympic Games.

title: Chinese Fentanyl Sanctions Act
snippet: To impose sanctions with respect to the trafficking of synthetic opioids originating in the People's Republic of China.

title: World Trade Organization Reform Act
snippet: To direct the United States Trade Representative to pursue reform of dispute settlement at the World Trade Organization.

title: Foster Care Stability Act
snippet: To improve placement stability for children in foster care and support kinship caregivers.

title: Pharmaceutical Ingredient Independence Act
snippet: To reduce dependence on foreign sources of active pharmaceutical ingredients through domestic production incentives.

title: Pacific Islands Partnership Act
snippet: To expand diplomatic and development engagement with Pacific Island nations in response to growing strategic competition in the region.

title: Highway Safety Improvement Act
snippet: To reauthorize Federal highway safety programs and fund improvements at high-crash rural intersections.

title: Apprenticeship Expansion Act
snippet: To expand registered apprenticeship programs in the skilled trades through grants to community colleges.

title: Korean Peninsula Peace Act
snippet: To encourage diplomatic engagement toward a formal end to the Korean War and denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula.

title: Honoring Our Firefighters Act
snippet: To establish a national memorial and expand death benefits for firefighters who die in the line of duty.

title: Foreign Adversary Telecom Review Act
snippet: To formalize the process for reviewing telecommunications licenses held by companies subject to foreign adversary jurisdiction.

title: Allied Shipbuilding Cooperation Act
snippet: To permit maintenance of United States naval vessels at shipyards in allied Indo-Pacific nations.

title: Honey Bee Habitat Act
snippet: To promote pollinator habitat on Federal highway rights-of-way and conservation reserve lands.

title: North American Steel Tariff Review Act
snippet: To review the application of section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminum imports from Canada and Mexico.

title: Quad Cooperation Enhancement Act
snippet: To deepen cooperation among the United States, Japan, India, and Australia on maritime security and critical technology standards.

title: Fair Trade With China Enforcement Act
snippet: To amend the Harmonized Tariff Schedule to increase duties on goods imported from the People's Republic of China in strategic sectors.

title: AUKUS Implementation Act
snippet: To facilitate the transfer of submarine technology among Australia, the United Kingdom, and the United States under the AUKUS partnership.

title: Chinese Student Visa Security Act
snippet: To require additional screening of visa applicants affiliated with universities connected to the military of the People's Republic of China.

title: Organ Donation Modernization Act
snippet: To modernize the organ procurement and transplantation network and improve donor registry interoperability.

title: Outbound Investment Transparency Act
snippet: To require notification of United States investments in sensitive technologies in countries of concern.

title: Great Lakes Restoration Act
snippet: To reauthorize the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative and address invasive species in the Great Lakes basin.

title: Chesapeake Bay Cleanup Act
snippet: To reauthorize the Chesapeake Bay program and fund agricultural runoff reduction practices.

title: Global Vaccine Distribution Act
snippet: To support equitable international distribution of vaccines through multilateral institutions.
